objective: train one flower-specific detector on the complete JRC development split, convert its boxes to category-free masks with a separately pretrained fixed segmenter, and qualify the composite estimator once on the untouched point-disjoint JRC test split

immutable_v3_stop.rule: never rerun, retune, round or reinterpret SegFormer ROI v3

jrc_source.source: European Commission JRC Flower Detection dataset from the 2018 LUCAS grassland module
jrc_source.published_point_split: the source paper split 250 original LUCAS points before slicing; the public train directory pools 300 training and 100 validation slices from 200 points, while the 100 test slices come from 50 other points
jrc_source.development_use: all 400 public train images and every positive-area clipped box; the one v3-frozen zero-intersection source box remains recorded but cannot become a training target
jrc_source.locked_use: all 100 public test images exactly once after the trained-weight hash, executable identity and development result are committed
jrc_source.prohibited: no test image decode, score-threshold search, epoch selection, architecture selection or retry after observing locked outcomes

detector.licence: AGPL-3.0; trained weights and integration remain subject to that licence

training.weight_selection: last epoch only; never best epoch

inference.matching: predictions in descending confidence order, each matched to the unmatched evaluable reference box with greatest IoU; ties by smallest reference annotation id

mask_generator.analysis_canvas: preserve aspect ratio with bilinear resize into a 1024 by 1024 canvas and equal 114/255 RGB padding split floor-before-ceiling-after
mask_generator.prompt: detector box top-left label 2 and bottom-right label 3 on the analysis canvas; no points, text, colours or manual prompts
mask_generator.candidate_selection: largest predicted-IoU value; exact ties choose the lowest output index
mask_generator.spatial_constraint: intersect the hard candidate mask with its detector box
mask_generator.union: union every retained instance mask; no morphology, component filtering, centre prior or colour prior

image_measurement.orientation: apply EXIF orientation then convert once to RGB
image_measurement.background: union of 25-percent width-and-height expansions around every detector box, minus every unexpanded detector box and every flower mask, clipped to the image
image_measurement.horizontal_flip: run the complete detector and mask generator independently on a horizontal flip, unflip the union mask and background mask, then compare with the original orientation
image_measurement.recorded_colour: continuous CIELAB distribution from original-image pixels under the original-orientation union flower mask; retain background distribution separately
image_measurement.admission: at least one retained instance plus both pixel minima and both horizontal-flip criteria; every failure remains in the frozen denominator

development.role: training-domain fail-fast only; never independent performance evidence
development.failure_rule: commit all rows and STOP before the locked test

locked_test.failure_rule: commit all rows and STOP; do not open Oxford-102 or scaleout pixels

ordered_execution: validate this contract and all immutable parents
prepare the 400-image training set without reading the test image directory
train exactly 50 epochs and retain the last epoch only
hash and commit the trained weight plus all training evidence
run all 400 development images and commit the development decision
only after a development pass, decode and score all 100 JRC test images exactly once
only after a locked JRC pass, run the already frozen Oxford-102 proxy and the complete scaleout measurement
claim_ceiling: A passing composite estimator supports automated flower-candidate localization and continuous camera-space colour measurement under independent JRC field-box validation; it does not establish pixel-perfect petals, taxon-uniform error, calibrated reflectance, pollinator vision, causation, adaptation or unrestricted commercial use.
